tip.title: Right there
tip.text: Some answers are RIGHT THERE in the text. Take a key word from the question, find it in the passage, and read the sentence around it. The answer is usually in that same sentence. Do not guess from memory. Go back and check.

passage.title: The Tryout
passage.text:
Jom was the shortest player at the tryout. The gym was hot and loud. Thirty boys wanted ten spots on the school team.

Coach Ferrer blew his whistle. "Three laps, then drills," he said. Jom ran hard. He was not fast, but he did not stop.

In the shooting drill, Jom missed four shots in a row. A tall boy named Ryan laughed. Jom said nothing. He kept shooting. His fifth shot went in. So did his sixth.

At the end, Coach read ten names. Jom's name was not on the list. He picked up his bag and walked to the door.

"Jom," Coach called. "I need a team manager. You work harder than anyone here. Interested?"

Jom turned around. "Yes, Coach," he said. It was not the spot he wanted. But it was a spot.

words.meaning: practice exercises done again and again
words.example: The team did passing drills for an hour.

words.meaning: a place or position, like on a team
words.example: There is one spot left on the bus.

words.meaning: a person who helps run a team or group
words.example: The team manager keeps the uniforms and the water.

items.prompt: How many spots were on the team?
items.why: The text says, "Thirty boys wanted ten spots on the school team."

items.prompt: What did Coach tell the boys to do first?

choices: How many laps the boys ran
Jom ran hard and did not stop, even though he was slow
items.why: The paragraph ends with the point: "He was not fast, but he did not stop." The whistle and the laps are details that lead to it.

items.prompt: Put the events in the order they happened.
steps: Jom missed four shots in a row.
Coach offered Jom the manager spot.
items.why: The story goes: laps, the shooting drill, the list of names, then Coach calling Jom back.

items.prompt: What job did Coach offer Jom? (one or two words)
items.why: Coach said, "I need a team manager."

items.prompt: What happened right AFTER Jom missed four shots in a row?
items.why: "Jom missed four shots in a row. A tall boy named Ryan laughed." The laugh comes right after the misses.

items.prompt: What did Jom do right BEFORE Coach called his name?
choices: He picked up his bag and walked to the door.
items.why: "He picked up his bag and walked to the door." Then the next line is Coach calling, "Jom."

choices: Jom kept shooting even after he missed
items.why: The paragraph goes from four misses to "He kept shooting" to his fifth and sixth shots going in. Ryan's laugh is one detail inside that.

items.prompt: What is this passage mostly about?
choices: A coach who reads ten names
A short boy who does not make the team but earns a spot by working hard
A tall boy who laughs at others
items.why: Every paragraph shows Jom working hard, and the ending is Coach saying, "You work harder than anyone here." The gym and Ryan are small details.
